sourceRefs.locator: IV.79, pp. 66–67, including n. 1. Illness at Épinay, Aega, Nanthild, Clovis and burial at Saint-Denis. Wallace-Hadrill follows Courtois in dating the death to 638.
Werk 2481 (BHL 2193), Beschreibung. Death of Dagobert in 639, composition by a monk of Saint-Denis between 830 and 835, and focus on his care for monasteries.
Introduction to the royal burials and section on the Merovingian basilica. Dagobert’s burial, present-day site and the date 639 used by the institution.
ARTEM 4511, Archives nationales AE II 6 (K 2 no. 3). Header, regest and ll. 3–4, naming the king’s parents Dagobert and Nanthild as buried in the basilica. Clichy, 22 June 654.

note.de: Die Fredegar-Chronik beschreibt die Beisetzung in der Basilika. Die heute vor Ort verwendete Datierung ist 639; die Ausgabe von Wallace-Hadrill gibt 638.
note.en: The Chronicle of Fredegar describes the burial in the basilica. The present-day monument uses 639; Wallace-Hadrill’s edition gives 638.
